name: Gletscherblick B&B
beschreibung:
Offering panoramic views over Ischgl, Gletscherblick B&B welcomes visitors with stylish guestrooms and a nourishing breakfast buffet. It makes a wonderful base for winter sports and summer hikes.

Ischgl cable car stations, the lively village core, and Paznaun trails are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gletscherblick B&B in Ischgl provides contemporary comfort and rapid access to the Silvretta Arena.
